_readme:
Conditional checks offered at PO setup, per top-level product category.

Chloe ticks the ones that apply when she sets up the report link in Order Management. The chosen triggers are stored on the PO under qaReports.<stage>.setup, and every question belonging to a ticked trigger is added to an 'Additional Review' section at the bottom of Step 5 of the QA report.

media: 'on_fail' = photo or video required only when the answer is Fail. 'photo_always' / 'video_always' = required whatever the answer, because the evidence IS the check.

Every question is answered Pass / Fail with no N/A - a trigger is only ticked when the feature is actually present - and a Fail always requires the quantity affected.

This file is required directly from the repo (like categories.json), so edits here deploy normally.
